context: A mom and son chat at home
purpose: Teach: 吹雪/かぜ/つゆ/ぬき/エスカレーター/キッズ/段差/中高

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、外、本気で、絶対、吹雪、絶対、ひどくなってきたわよ
lines.en: Sho, the blizzard outside is getting really bad. We need to be careful.
lines.style: Alert but not alarmed. Maternal concern with a practical edge. Clear articulation, moderate pace. Speaking to a child who needs information, not drama.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、かぜ、絶対、ひいたかも
lines.en: Mom, I think I might be getting a cold.
lines.style: Quiet admission, a little uncertain. Small voice. Not complaining — just reporting a fact he's noticed about himself. Seeks reassurance more than sympathy.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お蕎麦の、本気で、絶対、つゆ、絶対、ママ、絶対、温めてあるからね、翔くん
lines.en: I've got soba broth warming for you, Sho. It'll help.
lines.style: Warm and maternal. Slow, deliberate — the reassurance of a mother who has already thought ahead. Soft opening on the offer itself, like tucking him in with words.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼく、本気で、絶対、ピーマン、絶対、ぬき、絶対、で、絶対、食べてもいい?ママ
lines.en: Mom, can I eat the soba without the peppers?
lines.style: Hopeful, testing. Child's voice with a slight upward lift at the end — a request dressed as a question. Genuine curiosity about whether he'll be allowed.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: デパートの、本気で、絶対、エスカレーター、絶対、混んでるから、絶対、気をつけてね、翔くん
lines.en: The escalators at the department store get very crowded. Watch your step carefully, okay?
lines.style: Practical instruction delivered with quiet firmness. Not urgent, but clear. The tone of someone giving safety information she's given before and will give again.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 公園の、本気で、絶対、キッズ、絶対、スペース、絶対、ぼく、絶対、楽しいよ、ママ
lines.en: The kids' area in the park is really fun.
lines.style: Bright, animated. Small voice sharing something good he noticed. Enthusiasm that's genuine but not performed — just a child talking about something he likes.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 玄関の、本気で、絶対、段差、絶対、気をつけてね、翔くん
lines.en: Be careful of the step at the entrance, alright?
lines.style: Quiet, maternal reminder. Not alarmed — just the repetition of a mother noticing hazards and naming them gently. Steady, weathered tone of everyday caregiving.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お兄ちゃん、本気で、絶対、中高、絶対、一貫校に、絶対、通ってるんだよね、ママ
lines.en: Mom, my older brother goes to combined middle and high school, right?
lines.style: Curious, seeking confirmation. Thoughtful child's voice, genuinely interested in clarifying something about his brother's world. Quiet attention — not demanding, just wondering aloud.
